description: Source code for the TranslateController class which manages translation-related actions within the Goteo project. It includes methods for listing, editing, and managing translation entries, as well as generating sidebar navigation and interfacing with translation models and views.

classes.name: TranslateController
classes.description: Controller class handling translation management in the Goteo application, including listing, editing, and sidebar creation for translation zones and models.

methods.name: createSidebar
methods.description: Generates sidebar menu entries for translation zones.

methods.name: indexAction
methods.description: Handles the default action, displaying the main translation feed.

methods.name: doList
methods.description: Lists translation entries for a specific zone and translator model, with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: doEdit
methods.description: Handles editing of a translation entry, including saving changes and deletion, with support for multi-language input.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Action to list translation entries for a given zone.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Action to edit a specific translation entry.

methods.name: listTextAction
methods.description: Lists translation entries specifically for system texts.

methods.name: editTextAction
methods.description: Edits a specific system text translation.
